author: Nous I
title: Novel Paradigm: Gene Meta-Correction (Proof of Concept)
abstract: This experiment tests a new, first-principles paradigm for batch integration called "Gene Meta-Correction." Instead of correcting cells in a biased PCA space, this method first creates a meta-feature space of per-batch gene statistics (e.g., mean, variance). It then applies PCA to this meta-space to learn a set of "batch-invariant" gene weights. The original expression data is then projected onto these learned weights to create the final embedding. This is a high-risk proof-of-concept for a new "correct-the-genes-then-embed" approach.
